lines.t: The butterfly's dance is like a sweet romance
They glide through the sky in a heavenly dance
2 The male's beautiful wings have tiny scales that reach out to their mate, the beautiful females.
And the Lord's grand design brings forth a cocoon
Getting ready to hatch from a leaf very soon
This just period will take just a while
But when it is finished, the wings will have style
From a cocoon to a butterfly this creature becomes
And with a heavenly language only they could know
Is revealed in the song with a heavenly flow
Praise Yahushua, our King, who reigns on high
